It opened a narrow drawer holding a photograph of the lighthouse before its tower was built, and a second note in her father’s hand: “You were right to stay.” By dawn, Mara had decided to open the sealed room.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台刚停下来的机器，仍在暗处轻轻发热。路口的红灯照着空荡荡的斑马线，便利店门口堆着刚送来的牛奶。清洁车沿街缓缓驶过，水痕映出路灯的淡黄。高楼窗口偶尔亮起一格，像有人在梦里醒来。早点铺掀开蒸笼，白雾升起，很快散进冷清的街道。远处传来第一班公交车的声音，轮胎碾过井盖，清脆地响了一下。城市还没有真正醒来，却已悄悄准备好迎接新的一天。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It needs a stopping rule, like reaching the smallest nesting doll.\n- For example, to count a stack of books, count one book and then count the rest the same way."}
